items.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
items.summary: Google Research released Harness2, an Apache-2.0 framework that rewrites an agent's harness at test time. One refinement step lifted GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench with no weight updates. The post Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Voxel51 3.0: A Unified Multimodal Data Platform for Physical AI
items.summary: Voxel51 3.0 merges search, curation, annotation and evaluation of multimodal sensor data into one platform for physical AI teams. It adds Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset versioning, and a free self-service tier. The post Meet Voxel51 3.0: A Unified Multimodal Data Platform for Physical AI appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Kyutai, with Inria and École des Ponts, has released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) for robot manipulation. The REKI vision-language-action model is pretrained only on public data. It also carries a cheap memory of its recent past. On three out-of-distribution benchmarks, only models about twice its size beat it. items.title: 20 Jev Alternatives: The Decision Models Taking On TypeSafe in 2026
items.summary: TypeSafe launched Jev on September 15, 2026. It is a decision model, not a chatbot. You define the allowed answers, and Jev returns a label, a score or a yes/no probability. In about 4 weeks, at least 20 Jev alternatives shipped. They come from Cloudflare, OpenAI, Perplexity, Liquid AI, AWS’s Strands Labs and independent developers. items.summary: StepFun has released Step 5 Preview as open weights. FP8 and BF16 checkpoints are live on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Step 5 Preview is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from StepFun built for long-horizon agentic work. It has 600B total parameters, 27B active per token and up to 1M tokens of context. items.title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
items.summary: Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens. The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context
items.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight MoE model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context. It leads open models on MCP-Atlas and runs on 2 M5 Ultra Mac Studios. The post Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.
